claims.gist: A Magic Quadrant positions providers on execution of vision and market performance
Use a Magic Quadrant as a first step, not the final word on providers
Focusing on leaders is not always best; challengers and niche players may fit better
Interactive features let buyers reweight criteria to build a custom quadrant
Peer Insights user reviews are combined with the interactive Magic Quadrant

thesis: Magic Quadrants are a first-step view of providers; leaders are not always the right fit, so weigh your own goals.
